title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 11 October 2026
description: A shock pole position at the Bathurst 1000 and a fighting innings from Matt Renshaw in Durban, Queensland's Coomera Connector cost blowout, plus the Gold Coast Suns' Ben King saga finally reaching its conclusion. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
